d:
Get another glimpse of Ishaan & Janhvi's crackling chemistry in this high energy and upbeat song Zingaat from the movie Dhadak.
There is an altogether new exciting way to experience this song in a game, playing like a musician. A lot of music lovers are enjoying it.
Singer - Ajay-Atul
Music - Ajay-Atul
Lyricist - Amitabh Bhattacharya
Cast - Ishaan & Janhvi
Production House - Zee Studios & Dharma Productions
Producers - Karan Johar, Zee Studios, Hiroo Yash Johar & Apoorva Mehta
